title: Not worth the price
text: I was expecting more from an Allure curatef beauty box but it's the same as with other beauty box companies I've subscribed to before.  Yes, there are a couple of full sizes (just barely) of some brand you've never heard of and looks questionable to place on your skin. And the "bag"...well, I have sandwich bags better than this piece of junk.  Mostly cheap makeup not customized to each customers skin tone or preferences, age, skin type.  Waste of money at $15..canceled when advised price going up to $23!
label: neutral
